summary: Removes site-specific details and changes one agent behaviour. Agent 0.28.0 (ADR-0051, proposed): loadConfig refuses a configuration whose top-level mapping has a key no Config field reads (keys derived by reflection from the struct's YAML names, YAML merge keys allowed, nested keys still lenient); setup no longer renames the secret-store block from its pre-0.9.0 name. Traced: loadConfig callers (service start, check-config, setup probes in migrateLegacyInstall and setupUpgradeConfig, the updater's check-config of the new binary before the swap). A refused configuration stops the start, makes setup stop before it touches the service, and ends a self-update as a failed order with the old binary kept; no restart loop, no privilege or trust change, no new input source (the same local admin-owned file is parsed a second time into a yaml.Node, under the same yaml.v3 alias limits). Router 0.18.3: budget display texts (log lines, skip reason, HA problem texts, settings label, web UI I18N keys and placeholders, Grafana title) no longer name a currency; budget enforcement, fields, metric names and the HA sensor unit are unchanged; the UI change keeps the template structure and escaping (fmtCost formats a number only). Comments drop a personal name and a former device name; German prose, comments and UI strings use standard spelling (the privacy rule regex that accepts both spellings and the dataset templates' ASCII text are unchanged). Tests use documentation-range addresses with the same meaning (non-loopback remote, IPv4 anonymised). The privacy dataset builder's template lists changed; the committed data and the trained head are unchanged, so the runtime classifier (B7) is unchanged. docs/security/threat-model.de.md has spelling-only changes and needs the maintainer's explicit look as a policy document. No workflow, checker, skill, register or English threat-model change. No finding introduced.

limitations: Unknown nested keys are still ignored by the agent (deliberate scope of ADR-0051).
go test ran on Windows only; the elevated Windows setup flow was not executed.
The privacy dataset builder now differs from its committed data; a regenerated dataset needs retraining and a new evaluation against the hand-written test set before the head is replaced.

Identifiers, configuration keys, API fields and metric names that contain a currency code, the role name of the large tier, the HA sensor unit, the AHV rule of the privacy check and the training data were left unchanged on purpose.
A passing evidence check proves freshness and structure only, not that no vulnerability exists.
